source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 202 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-202.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 202 was established by Ordinance No. 18731, passed by the Dallas City Council on May 29, 1985. Ordinance No. 18731 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. Ordinance No. 18731 was amended by Ordinance No. 18952, passed by the Dallas City Council on December 4, 1985; Ordinance No. 21031, passed by the Dallas City Council on August 28, 1991; Ordinance No. 21533, passed by the Dallas City Council on January 13, 1993; and Ordinance No. 23469, passed by the Dallas City Council on March 25, 1998. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 18731; 18952; 21031; 21533; 23469; 25711; 27920)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-202.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 202 is established on property generally located on the east line of Preston Road, north of the north line of Crownover Court. The size of PD 202 is approximately 3.997 acres. (Ord. Nos. 18731; 25711; 27920)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-202.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(1) In this article: TATTOO OR BODY PIERCING STUDIO means a business in which tattooing or body piercing is performed. TATTOOING means the practice of producing an indelible mark or figure on the human body by scarring or inserting a pigment under the skin using needles, scalpels, or other related equipment. BODY PIERCING means the piercing of body parts, other than ears, to allow the insertion of jewelry.

(2) CHANGEABLE MESSAGE SIGN means a sign composed of LED/LCD elements, slide lettering, slated rotating surfaces, or other changeable message technology that displays different designs or advertisements.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered to be a nonresidential zoning district. (Ord. Nos. 25711; 27920)

SEC. 51P-202.103.1. EXHIBIT.

The following exhibit is incorporated into this article: Exhibit 202A: development and landscape plan. (Ord. 27920)

sections.title: Development And Landscape Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-202.104. DEVELOPMENT AND LANDSCAPE PLAN.

Development and use of the Property must comply with the development and landscape plan (Exhibit 202A). If there is a conflict between the text of this article and the development and landscape plan, the text of this article controls. (Ord. Nos. 21533; 23469; 25711; 27920)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-202.105. LANDSCAPING.

(a) Landscaping must be provided as shown on the development and landscape plan (Exhibit 202A). If there is a conflict between the text of this article and the development and landscape plan, the text of this article controls.

(b) Plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition. (Ord. Nos. 21031; 21533; 25711; 27920)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-202.106. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

(a) Except as provided in this section, the only main uses permitted are those main uses permitted in the NS(A) Neighborhood Service District, subject to the same conditions applicable in the NS(A) Neighborhood Service District, as set out in Chapter 51A. For example, a use permitted in the NS(A) Neighborhood Service District only by specific use permit (SUP) is permitted in this district only by SUP; a use subject to development impact review (DIR) in the NS(A) Neighborhood Service District is subject to DIR in this district, etc.

(b) The following main uses are permitted by right:

-- Animal shelter or clinic without outside runs. -- Financial institution with drive-in window. -- General merchandise or food store greater than 3,500 square feet. -- Restaurant without drive-in or drive-through service.

(c) The following uses are prohibited:

-- Adult day care facility. -- Attached non-premise sign. -- Carnival or circus (temporary). -- College, dormitory, fraternity, or sorority house. -- Convent or monastery. -- Country club with private membership. -- Crop production. -- Massage parlor. -- Motor vehicle fueling station. -- Private recreation center, club, or area.

-- Radio, television, or microwave tower. -- Recycling drop-off container. -- Recycling drop-off for special occasion collection. -- Tattoo or body piercing studio. -- Temporary concrete or asphalt batching plant. -- Tower/antenna for cellular communication. (Ord. Nos. 21533; 25711; 27920)

SEC. 51P-202.106.1. ACCESSORY USES.

As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A-4.217. (Ord. 27920)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-202.107. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(Note: The yard, lot, and space regulations in this section must be read together with the yard, lot, and space regulations in Division 51A-4.400. If there is a conflict between this section and Division 51A-4.400, this section controls.)

(a) In general. Except as provided in this section, the yard, lot, and space regulations for the NS(A) Neighborhood Service District apply.

(b) Floor area. Maximum floor area for all uses combined is 34,175 square feet.

(c) Height. Maximum structure height is 24 feet.

(d) Setbacks. Minimum setbacks are as follows:

(1) From the northern boundary line of the Property, 15 feet.

(2) From the eastern and southeastern boundary lines of the Property, 55 feet.

(3) From the southern boundary line of the Property, 25 feet.

(4) From the western boundary line on the Preston Road right-of-way, 25 feet.

(e) Stories. Maximum number of stories above grade is one. (Ord. Nos. 21533; 25711; 27920)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-202.109. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. Nos. 21533; 25711; 27920)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-202.110. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

(a) Except as provided in this section, consult the use regulations in Division 51A- 4.200 for the specific off-street parking and loading requirements for each use.

(b) A minimum of 124 off-street parking spaces must be provided on the Property.

(c) For an animal shelter or clinic without outside runs off-street parking must be provided at a ratio of one space for each 400 square feet of floor area.

(d) For purposes of this section, the Property is considered one lot.

(e) Compact parking is not allowed. (Ord. Nos. 21533; 25711; 27920)

sections.title: Screening
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-202.111. SCREENING.

A six-foot-high solid screening wall must be provided and maintained on the northern boundary of the Property. An eight-foot-high solid screening wall must be provided and maintained along the southern boundary of the Property. The screening wall required along the southern boundary of the Property must be erected prior to the issuance of a certificate of occupancy for the south building. (Ord. Nos. 21533; 25711; 27920)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-202.112. SIGNS.

(a) Except as provided in this section, signs must comply with the provisions for non- business zoning districts in Article VII.

(b) One detached monument premise sign with a maximum effective area of 120 square feet, a maximum height of 11.5 feet, and located a minimum of 7.8 feet from the Property line and identified as Sign #1 on the development and landscape plan, is allowed on Lot 15, City Block C/8734. This detached monument sign must comply with the sign elevation shown on the development and landscape plan by October 23, 2010. Slide lettering or other manual process that places different designs, messages, or advertisements on the sign is allowed.

(c) One new multi-tenant monument detached premise sign shall replace the existing detached sign located on Lot 16, City Block C/8734 identified as Sign #2 on the development and landscape plan by June 23, 2013. This new sign must comply with the sign elevation shown on the development and landscape plan identified as Sign #2. This sign shall have a maximum effective area of 180 square feet, a maximum height of 15 feet, and a minimum setback of 25 feet.

(d) Except as provided in this section, changeable message signs are prohibited.

(e) The maximum number of detached premise signs on the Property is two. (Ord. Nos. 23469; 25711; 27920)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-202.113. PAVING.

(a) All parking spaces, aisles, maneuvering areas, and driveway connections to streets or alleys, whether enclosed or unenclosed, must be surfaced to comply with the Dallas Development Code.

(b) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 18731; 21533; 25711; 27920)

sections.title: Maintenance
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-202.114. MAINTENANCE.

The Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance. (Ord. Nos. 21533; 25711; 27920)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-202.115. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.

Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 21533; 25711; 27920)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-202.116. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

(a) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.

(b) The building official shall not issue a building permit to authorize work, or a certificate of occupancy to authorize the operation of a use, until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 18731; 25711; 27920)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-202.117. ZONING MAP.

PD 202 is located on Zoning Map No. AA-7. (Ord. Nos. 18731; 25711; 27920)
